title: Unverified pivot links, code search and dork links (batch p2-G14-3)
owner: batch p2-G14-3 (P304 pivots_unverified, P305 code_search, P306 dork_generator)

attributes.code_search_hits: public code locations that mention the investigated value, one entry per repository (top 10): {repo, provenance (own_repo | third_party_repo | public_ioc_repo), wording, severity, hit_count, rules (P312 pattern ids), dedup (keyed hashes of masked matches), hits [{source, path, line, commit, link}]} - fragments are never kept and secrets are never shown, tested or reused
attributes.code_search_hostnames: hostnames under the investigated apex found in masked public-code fragments (code_search); leads for internal names, never fetched
attributes.code_search_summary: code search coverage of one entity: {providers (queried sources and outcome), queries, total_repos, total_hits, overflow (repositories beyond the top 10)}
attributes.br_phone_variants: offline Brazilian phone formats derived from the E.164 value for manual search (+55 11 9xxxx-xxxx, (11) 9xxxx-xxxx, 119xxxxxxxx, with and without the mobile 9); never sent anywhere by V3LUM

tags.public_ioc_repo: the hit is in a public IOC or blocklist repository: context only, never an independent malicious vote (P171)
tags.third_party_repo: a public repository not attributed to the organisation mentions the value
tags.own_repo: repository of one of the organisation's own code-host accounts (setting code_search_org_accounts)

relations.mentioned_in_code: investigated value -> blob URL of a public code file that mentions it (repo/path/line; listed with expand=False)
relations.code_repo_owner: investigated value -> account owning a public repository whose code mentions it (a lead, not an identity; expand=False)
